integrity: Proof derives the density from all moments, proves exact strict positivity through pi and a Rouché-controlled eventual real-zero asymptotic; computational checks supplement rather than replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Diagonal Fourier direction only; first-zero norm of the full Fourier null variety is not determined. Complex zeros inside a fixed compact set are not classified. Asymptotic coefficients are fixed-dimension, nonuniform in dimension. Exact reverse-Legendre density may have an equivalent older spline/tomography formulation.
title: Reverse-Legendre cross-polytope marginals and the asymptotic phase of axial Fourier zeros
